title: Careers

mods.html:
Welcome to the careers page of NeoVentraX, where a world of professional opportunities awaits you. Our company thrives on diversity, offering a wide array of career paths across various departments and specializations.

Each career avenue is designed to cater to different skills and aspirations. Whether you’re an experienced professional or a fresh graduate, we have opportunities that will challenge you and help you grow.

Join our team as a React JS Developer and help create dynamic, high-performing web applications. You will use your skills in JavaScript, React, and modern front-end technologies to develop responsive and interactive user interfaces. Collaborate with designers and back-end developers to translate designs and requirements into functional components.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain responsive web applications using React JS.

  • Develop interactive features that enhance user experience and performance.

  • Work closely with UI/UX designers to implement designs and wireframes.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.

  • Integrate front-end components with back-end APIs.

  • Optimize applications for speed, scalability, and efficiency.

  • Participate in code reviews and team discussions.

Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and React JS.

  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles.

  • Experience with state management tools such as Redux.

  • Problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work in a team-oriented environment.

If you are passionate about creating amazing web experiences and enjoy working in a collaborative environment, we would love to hear from you!

Job description

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Candidate Sourcing: Identify potential candidates through various channels such as job boards, social media, networking events, and employee referrals. Screen resumes and applications to match candidates with the appropriate non-IT roles.
  2. Interview Coordination: Schedule and conduct initial interviews to assess candidates’ qualifications, cultural fit, and overall suitability for the role. This may include phone, video, or in-person interviews.
  3. Candidate Management: Maintain positive relationships with candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing timely updates, feedback, and guidance.
  4. Offer Negotiation and Closing: Extend job offers to selected candidates and negotiate salary and other employment terms. Ensure a smooth onboarding process for new hires.
  5. Recruitment Strategy Development: Contribute to the development and implementation of recruitment strategies to attract top talent. This may include employer branding initiatives, participation in job fairs, and developing new sourcing channels.
  6. Compliance and Record-Keeping: Ensure all recruitment activities are compliant with relevant laws, regulations, and company policies. Maintain accurate records of all recruitment activities.
  7. Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about trends and best practices in recruitment. Suggest improvements to the recruitment process to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a recruiter, with a focus on non-IT roles.
  • Strong understanding of recruitment processes and candidate selection methods.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • NeoVentraX in using recruitment software and candidate management systems.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in specific industries relevant to the company (e.g., manufacturing, healthcare, retail, etc.).
  • Knowledge of employment law and HR best practices.
